# Turkey chilli

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Per serving** | 620 kcal · 48 g P · 70 g C · 16 g F |
| **Slot** | lunch, dinner |
| **Prep** | cook · 40 min · serves 4 |
| **Nutrition** | estimated |
| **Tags** | batch |
| **Status** | active |

## Ingredients
- 500 g turkey mince, 5% fat
- 2 chopped tomatoes, tin
- 1 kidney beans, tin
- 1 onion
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 300 g basmati rice
<!-- coach:end card turkey-chilli -->

## Method
1. Soften the onion in the oil, brown the mince.
2. Add the tomatoes and beans; simmer 25 minutes.
3. Cook the rice; portion into four tubs.
